hook.name: DelistGameHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the IndexPVP game that collects protocol fees (flat 1% + volatility-based dynamic component) on all swaps, overriding LP fees to 0. Includes per-pool circuit-breaker sell surcharges (up to 90%) and a global halt-window sell fee (20%), with liquidity and trading access restricted to a game contract.
